abrazar: to embrace; to take up (a course)
abrigo: shelter; "al abrigo de" under cover of
acabamos: we finished; «acabamos de» we have just
alcances: reach; «a mis alcances»: within my power
boca: mouth; "boca de" at the mouth of
cargar: to load; (cargar sobre) to dwell on
cargo: "a cargo de" in the charge of
común: common; "patrimonio cultural común" public domain (Chilean designation)
consecuente: "más consecuente" most far-reaching in its consequences
consigo: with itself; "trajo consigo" brought with it
contrario: contrary; "por el contrario" on the contrary
costa: "a costa de" at the expense of
cuantas: as many as; all the ... that
cuanto: how much; "en cuanto" as soon as; "cuanto" all that
cuantos: all those who; as many as
cuenta: account; por su cuenta: at their own risk
dejar: to leave; to let; "dejar de" to fail to
echarán: will cast; (echar de menos) will miss
entregármelos: to hand them over to me
espaldas: back; (volver las espaldas) turns his back
favor: favour; "en favor de" in favour of
fines: ends; (a fines de) at the end of
hacerle: to make him; to do to him
le: to him, to her, to it
mediados: (a mediados de) in the middle of
merced: a la merced de: at the mercy of
mío: my; Muy señor mío: Dear Sir
placer: pleasure; will (a placer de: at the will of)
prestarme: to lend me; to show me
sea: be (subj.); "que sea" however ... it may be
so: under; so pena de: on pain of
sí: yes; itself ("sobre sí", "por sí mismos" by themselves)
tocar: to touch; (tocar los extremos) to go to extremes
vela: sail; «dar la vela»: to set sail
vista: sight; "a primera vista" at first sight
